changeinfo.changes:
• Fixed an issue where certain endgame trophies won't trigger if certain conditions are fufilled.
  • Minor cosmetic change to the e-manual.

Story mode:
  • Added an easy difficulty option for Story mode.
  • Game will now pause when the player opens the inventory in Story mode.
  • Fixed an issue where the dual-blade owls' charge attack, could sometimes cause unfair amounts of damage.
  • Increased the number of healthboxes dropped by enemies in skypaction.
  • Tweaked the hit detection for Hardboiled's punches.
Rescue mode:
  • Added an exploration condition for getting Stars in Rescue mode.
General:
  • Stability and performance improvements.
  • Reduced the angle of the screen tilts.
  • Changed the look of the player's crosshairs.
  • Improved the controls for interacting with ladders.
  • Improved the responsiveness for interacting with pickups.
  • Removed the ability to go down into a ledge grab from a standing or crouching position.
  • Reduced the damage of enemies wielding shotguns and grenade launchers.
  • Slightly reduced the damge of the enemies using the anti-matter gun.
  • Reduced the damage of body shots for sniper weapons.
Network:
  • Options to kick and invite players in an online session moved was moved from "Network" to "Host Options".

Rocketbirds 2 Evolution - Upgrades Patch - New Features:
  • Added Tutorial level for Rescue mode ( with full voice overs ).
  • Weapons and Armor can now be upgraded up to level 5.
  • Added the ability to assign weapons to npc allies.
  • Added Aim Assist ( can be toggled in controls ).
  • Added a Hard difficulty for Story mode.
  • Each location now contains 3 different length; Quick Mission, Normal Mission and Big Mission, each contains different rewards.
  • Owl Terminators will now spawn in Normal and Big Missions of Castle, Albatoir and Jungliana after the player opens the portal.
UI Changes:
  • Menu screen image and music changed.
  • Story mode is renamed to Part 1: Story mode.
  • Rescue mode is renamed to Part 2: Rescue mode.
  • Loading screen for Rescue levels have a different loading screen animation from Story mode.
  • Inventory UI design changed.
  • Inventory now only shows weapons and items that the player has unlocked.
  • Loading Screen for rescue mode has a different icon and texts.
Gameplay Changes:
  • Various improvements to game controls.
  • Various minor gameplay tweaks and improved gameplay feedback.
  • Rockets and Grenades now share the same ammo type.
  • New type of ammo for Hunting Rifle, Vintorez, and Lyxn Rifle: Skull Bullets.
  • Tweaks to cost of weapons and ammo.
  • Ammo cap has been reduced for each ammo type.
  • Improvement and bug fixes on enemy A.I
  • Mind jammer and phone jammer has been removed from inventory selection, and now has it's own button, D-pad right and D-pad left.
  • Weapons and clothing have been rebalanced.
Network:
  • Online match-making is now region locked.
General:
  • Stability and performance improvements.
  • Updated trophy descriptions to reflect changes in mode names.
• Fixed an issue while playing online: progress inside a level sometimes fails to save.
